notes.title: EvoWars -Monster Hunt Master Mode — Rebalanced! ⚔️💎
notes.content:
We've reworked the Master tier of Monster Hunt to offer a more exciting and challenging experience for veterans 💀⚔️


Here’s what’s new:



🔧 Balance Changes

🧟‍♂️ Enemy HP and rewards per kill have been reverted to original levels

🛡️ Enemies now gain scaling damage resistance with each wave

💎 Elites after wave 5 now always drop 5 shards

📉 Fixed: Players were dealing incorrect damage values compared to Collections


🧠 Why the change?

Master tier runs were dragging on for hours — some players reached wave 100+ solo 😵

The new scaling difficulty means shorter, more intense runs

Shard drops are now capped to encourage meaningful choices instead of mindless mass spending



⏱️ So while each run may be shorter and give fewer shards, your total rewards over the same playtime should remain just as strong — and way more fun.


🔥 Reaching wave 100 solo now?

Let’s just say… good luck. 😈

notes.title: 🐾 EvoWars - BIG UPDATE: Pets have joined the hunt! ⚔️
notes.content:
🐶 PETS (Monster Hunt only!) 

Unleash your new allies in Monster Hunt mode! You can now equip up to 5 active pets to fight alongside you.

🔧 How Pets Work:
⚔️ Automatically fight alongside you in Monster Hunt mode

💥 Deal percentage-based damage — the more HP an enemy has, the more they hurt!

🛡️ Elites and Bosses take reduced damage from pets, but they still feel the pain 😈

📈 Upgrade pets:

- 🎯 Number of targets hit

- 💥 Attack power

- 🔁 Cooldown reduction

-💎 XP gain from pets’ kills


🎁 How to get pets:
🗝️ From War Chests

🔺 Additionally:
💀 Slightly increased difficulty in Monster Hunt: Master Mode (Pets give a big advantage now — this change is for balance, especially for party teams and veteran hunters!)

💎 Fixed: Gems didn’t update properly after pulling duplicates

🕵️‍♂️ Cheater detection improvements

🔥 Go test your new companions and let us know what you think! See you in the Hunt, warriors 🐾⚔️

notes.title: EvoWars - Balance & Rewards Update! ⚔️💎
notes.content:
Another round of improvements, fixes, and quality-of-life changes is here. Let’s go! 🚀

🔧 Fixes & Improvements

 Fixed an issue on Steam where the tutorial would appear every time due to a broken local save.
 Fixed incorrect "Champions" stats in Tournaments.
 Fixed a bug where Apache upgrades showed the wrong currency.
 Improved spawn system - players now avoid dangerous or crowded spawn areas.
 Leaderboard now updates more quickly and accurately.
 Monster Hunt summary now displays properly at the end of the run.

🧬 Evolution System Rework

 Evolutions now reach their maximum size at level 36 (Annihilator).
 Megavolutions no longer grow in size, but still keep their dual weapon advantage.

This change is based on community feedback—early Megavolutions in Teams mode created an unfair advantage.

🛒 Shop & Collections Update

 The Shop has been separated from Collections.
 The shop now offers timed free rewards — and they get better the more you claim!
 The Premium account has been renamed to VIP. 👑

🖱️ UI & Visual Tweaks

 Custom cursor size reduced by 20% for better visibility.

⚔️ Duel Mode Reward Boost

 Duel rewards increased — your 6th win now gives 25 gems instead of 1! 💎

Enjoy the update, and as always — thanks for being part of the EvoWars community! 💬🔥
Let the battles continue! ⚔️

notes.title: ⚔️EvoWars - War Chest & Fair Play Update! 🎁⚔️
notes.content:
We've heard your feedback! This update improves War Chest rewards, removes unfair PvP penalties, adds unlimited shard storage, and introduces a new custom cursor!

War Chest Shard Rewards Increased
- War Chest now gives 10 to 15 shards instead of just 5!
- Shards are now distributed through special cards:

 1st-4th cards: A total of 10 shards (collected automatically).
 5th card ("Bonus Shards") contains 5 extra shards and is optional.
 Steam & Premium users get it automatically, while free players can collect it by watching an ad.

Shard Storage Limit Removed
Previously, you could only hold 10 shards per weapon before getting duplicates. Now, there's no limit! 🎉

New Custom Cursor
- A dedicated graphic cursor has been added for a better visual experience.
- Prefer the default system cursor? You can disable it in settings!

PvP Balance Fix
🚨 Removed the 90% XP & Score penalty for killing the same player twice within 60s.
✅ Players using Party Code will no longer see each other in Deathmatch mode.

This update improves progression, removes shard limits, rewards supporters, and enhances the UI! Enjoy the changes and keep evolving! 🔥⚔️

notes.title: EvoWars - War Chest Update! 🎁⚔️
notes.content:
Changes to War Chest loot and game economy! :gem:  

War Chest Loot System Rework  
- War Chest now drops shards for evolutions from level 1 up to your current rank level.  

Example: If your rank is 1, War Chest will drop shards only for Caveman evolution.  
If your rank is 2, it will drop shards for Caveman or Viking, and so on—up to rank 40, where War Chest can drop shards for all evolutions.  

What does this change?  
✅ New players will collect 10 shards for the same weapon faster, allowing them to upgrade weapons sooner and progress more quickly.  

✅ Unlocking alternative weapons for higher evolutions now requires a higher rank, making them a prestigious achievement.  

✅ Rank level now plays a crucial role in your progression!  

Other Changes & Fixes 
- War Chest price reduced from 100 to 25 gems!  
- Tomb spawn chance increased from 3% to 6%!  
- Empower skill now has a max level cap of 20. 
- Various minor fixes and improvements.  

Jump in and check out the new system! :fire:  

Let’s Fight! Kill! Evolve! ⚔️
Good Luck & Have Fun! 🎮🔥

notes.title: EvoWars: New Era finally on Steam !!!
notes.content:
The wait is over - EvoWars: New Era is officially available on Steam! 🚀

Buy EvoWars with 25% off on Steam and fight against players from all over the world or stand side by side with them to defeat your opponents.

Steam Version Perks:
- Gamepad support 🎮
- Improved performance & graphics 🖥️✨
- Quick respawn after death ⚡
- No ads, just pure action ❌📢
- Log in to your existing EvoWars account 🔑

Weapon Upgrade & Evolution System Overhaul:
- No more upgrade limits! Weapons can now be upgraded indefinitely.
- Each upgrade requires 10 shards and increases damage by 1 to 4, depending on rarity.
- Upgrade costs now scale with level.

War Chest Rework:
- Weapon Chest is now called War Chest.
- Now drops both weapons and evolution shards.
- Instead of 1 weapon, opening a chest now gives 5 shards.
- Upgrades can now be done directly from the loot screen.

Other Changes & Fixes:
NEW: Language selection added! Polish is the first supported language. 🇵🇱
New tutorial hints for beginners.
New default mount added. 🐎
New tooltips in various places.
Tombs now always auto-drop 💎 loot.
Total Damage of each level is now visible in the evolution list.
Various minor fixes and improvements.

Jump in and experience EvoWars like never before! 🔥⚔️
